nom: Klairs Freshly Juiced Vitamin E Mask

avis.texte: I love this so much. It's a gel like consistency and when it dries isn't tacky or sticky. When I wake up the next day my skin always looks more refreshed, and smooth. A little goes a long way! The one jar lasts quite awhile. I will definitely continue to repurchase!

avis.titre: I returned this after wanting it to work
avis.texte: I am very experienced with skincare. I looked over reviews and ingredients… i wanted to love it, but this mask is NOT it. It sits on top of your skin, does not absorb and my skin felt no different after use. I was sad but much better products are out there that dont just look and feel (jelly) like they would make a difference, but actaully do!

Ive actually lost count of how many jars of this stuff ive been through at this point. It is INCREDIBLE! My skin loves it! I have red, sensitive, combination, acne prone skin and i use this first thing in the morning and right after i shower in the evenings. Makeup sits beautifully on top of it with no issues.

avis.titre: weird texture, let it melt in your hands first
avis.texte: First off, I love this product, but... if you have texture issues, I will warn... You need to let this melt in your hands for a few seconds before you use it. Its a weird thick jelly like texture that rolls off your face if it isn't warmed up in your hands. It works great, just not a container to face application. I do love the fact that they give you a little spoon for the product.

Unfortunately, the jelly texture of this product doesn't work for me. I use it as an overnight mask, as my last step, and I struggle to dispense the product and spread it on my face. It's just a big goop that leaves my face sticky and uncomfortable.

My third purchase of this! Truly obsessed, I use it as both a sleeping mask and it also works well in the morning as a primer/moisturizer because it makes my skin a little sticky! Gives me more glow and hydration than any other product ive used.

avis.titre: my only favorite moisturizer for acne-prone skin
avis.texte: dear Kiehls, please keep this product in stock at all times! it is the only moisturizer that I have used in my 5 year hormonal acne journey that actually works!!! it doesn't break me out at all unlike other moisturizers. it makes my acne look less red and definitely less inflamed. I know it doesn't cater towards acne people but this is the holy grail!!! I will never go back to another moisturizer. and the bottle has lasted me a while as well! not only that but it is very moisturizing which I do not expect living in such a dry climate and using a gel moisturizer. love it 100%
Love this and will use regularly from now on. Very hydrating without a strong scent. Gives your skin a great glow
Love this and will use regularly from now on. Very hydrating without a strong scent. Gives your skin a great glow
Very hydrating, minimal scent, makes skin glow, and absorbs well
I'm not in love with this (yet), but I do like how lightweight it is and how quickly it absorbs. Seems to be great at hydrating without being oily or clogging pores. Will update after continued use.
I have two weeks using this E vitamin and I definitely love it! My skin feels more soft and looks more glow. This vitamin helps me with my dullness skin.

avis.titre: Love it, just a critique on packaging
avis.texte: Great product, only critque is the tiny spatula they provide is entirely useless, which is fine doesnt effect the product itself, it is however unnecessary n therefore wasteful. Since the product is like a flubber jelly consistency, it just slides right off so not only can u not use it for to apply to skin but u cant even scoop product up, its just an unnecessary waste to continue to include it with the product and it would be better to just not provide it at all.
Soothing. Love that it's jelly/flan-like. leaves my face feeling silky

I know this is technically a mask, but I use it as a moisturizer because it just soaks right into your skin in the best way. In the jar it's a jelly-like consistency that you need to scoop out but it melts easily into skin and doesn't leave noticeable residue like most masks. I have sensitive skin that tends to be dry and I feel glowy and bright using this. Absolutely love it, one of my favorite skin products ever. I got it on sale before but honestly, I'd pay full price for this. It lasts a long time.

avis.titre: You need this product in your AM routine! ASAP
avis.texte: This product is amazing for normal, dry skin or very dry skin. My AM Skin routine consist of Cerave Very Dry skin cleanser, Water base Hydroboost this product or CEO oil (I alternate one day CEO and the next day this), hydroacid serum, Moisture, Rose water and sunblock. As you can see my skin is very dry specially in winter where it gets terrible. So using this product in combination to all my other product has been great help and I have been recibing so many compliments of my skin. Sometimes, I just put mascara and eye liner because the skin looks amazing. Why I alternates this product? This makes my face feels very refresh and does feels nourish but my skin needs oil every 2 days at least to looks better. But I do believe that during summer I will not be alternating this product and just be using this only. I love how this product makes my face. You would see the results inmediately (at least how it feels) but the more you use this you would notice how healthy you skin is starting to look and the makeup looks way better.

I'm currently going through chemo and my skin is dried out and dull. This product has done wonders to keep my skin looking good AND because there's no scent, it doesn't induce nausea. Will be purchasing again and again.

I received this as a free gift with purchase, loved it so much I just ordered my second jar! I love how light and easily this literally melts into the skin. I use this daily as my morning moisturizer, my makeup goes on smoothly with no pilling, no primer. I keep this in a cosmetic refrigerator and it is dreamy, especially in the summer. I have noticed my skin is clearing (rosacea) and seems to be more even toned. The texture is that of jello. I have seen others comment on how to get the product out of the jar as it melts easily, I use my brush for masks, I dip it in once and thats enough for my whole face. The texture is like nothing I have ever used, it looks untouched whenever I open the jar. Its also very resonably priced, its definitely a keeper!

A little goes a long way- it's more expensive but considering it will last you a good long while and then some, it's worth every penny! I personally use just a dab of it as a daily moisturizer for my skincare routine. It may go quicker if you decide to use it as a nightly mask once or twice a week, but if you love your face, you'll love this
I don't understand the hype here. What am I missing? Its just a thick unscented lotion.

This is my favorite and holy-grail moisturizer. Ive repurchased more than 4 times and wikl continue to keep it stocked and pray it never discontinues. This jelly moisturizer melts intonyour skin when you massage it, and is quickly absorbed giving you a beautiful healthy glow. A big perk is that it is NOT OILY and so refreshing- great for the summer and for oily skin. I have dry skin and I STILL LOVE IT because it is hydrating. The vitamin E is a huge plus because I use vitamin C daily - this helps activate that vitamin C and have an enhanced effect. This moisturizer works great as a base for makeup. And it is amazing to travel - due to the jelly consistency, its easy and mess-free to scoop some into a travel size container. Love love love Klairs

I got this in a sample pack and I'm back to order the full size. I've had extremely dry skin this past winter and have been struggling. I've been putting this on my skin after washing it. I feel hydrated and smooth. It makes my face feel like silk. I absolutely LOVE the texture of this product - it's very interesting.
i got a sample of this with one of my orders and i love it! so hydrating and makes my skin feel super soft. i had some dry near my mouth and it made them go away super fast!

avis.titre: The only topical hydration I trust
avis.texte: I love this mas so much! Ive been buying it for about a year now, and it's only one i use for my oily skin without it being greasy or breaking me out. It thoroughly hydrates my skin and makes it feel soft and supple and helps with moisture balance. I love the jelly consistency and honestly, a little goes a long way.

I use this with the klairs vitamin c serum and the texture and consistency soaks into the skin so well. I put them on one at a time and then let them absorb for like 30 min before I follow up with a gentle moisturizer. It's still a tiny bit tacky before I use the moisturizer but not too noticeable. After the moisturizer it's undetectable
I've ever tried a cream with a texture like this. So light and nourish at the same time. I'm just in love!

What I love about this product is that it absorbs well onto the skin. The consistency is thick yet when applied to skin it's very absorbing, it's not cake-y and mixes well with other products/serum. I bought this product paired with my vitamin C serum or the freshly juiced vitamin drop. And the results are amazing!!!

This is my first time trying this mask and "wow" it absorbs incredibly well. Containing Vitamin E, Niacinamide & Adenosine this mask is so soothing and moisturizing. I like the lightweight cool gel like consistency and this mask makes my skin look more radiant and smoother. I have been using this mask overnight and it has helped to balance & even out my combination skin as well as it fades hyperpigmentation. This can be used as an overnight mask or a moisturizer and as an added bonus it boosts the effects of Vitamin C.
Super lovely texture, I use this just before I go to sleep and I wake up feeling refreshed than if I go to bed without anything on my face. Really moisturising.
The texture is easy to apply. Initially it leaves a residue but it's absorbed quick into the skin. It helps with keeping skin hydrated and takes redness away.

I got this as a sample and although I'm not sure I'll purchase it in the future I do like the product. It has an interesting jello like texture and kind of melts down nicely but I wouldn't personally use it as a moisturizer because I feel it leaves a tacky feeling behind so I only used it as a mask. It feels clarifying and brightening and I do believe it helped overall I just don't believe it's my personal holy grail.
This mask is what every women need in her skin routine, my skin feels better, I use it every night as a mask.
I really enjoy the pudding-like texture and I use it as an overnight mask. I wake up and my skin feels so soft! I like that it contains Vitamin E & Niacinamide.

Amazing amazing amazing! Literally one of the best that Klairs product I have ever tried. Even though it's a mask, I use it like a moisturizer. At first I didn't know how to work with the texture but I break it in between my hands and spread it on my face. It leaves my skin super glowy and plump without the greasiness. 100% recommend anyone to try this out!

avis.titre: I love this Klairs Vitamin E
avis.texte: Excellent product. I use it after exfoliating, peeling or retinol treatments. So refreshing.

I've gone through like 4 or 5 jars of this stuff I the past couple couple years. It's so amazing. Like many others I use this as a last step in my night routine. I like it extra thick because in the morning it's absorbed and my skin feels so soft. People have definitely commented on how nice my skin in and I've notice a more even skin tone when I used to have very red cheeks/jawline area.

This mask has pudding like texture, it is so new to me! I love it so much. I partnered it with vitamin c juice drop and they're the best combo for my skin problem. I have hyperpigmentation and acne marks on my face, and after months of using it I noticed that it really lessened and it leaves my skin so glowy. I little amount goes a long way this product is so worth my money. You guys have to try it! Now I understand why it sold millions!
I have been using this mask as a moisturizer and this is my all time fave. It gives you that dewy complexion.
It's one of my tried and trues, I've been using it for years and it never fails to prevent a breakout. Perfect for the dryer side of combination. Super hydrating without any oily-ness

avis.titre: makes my skin tone on my face even
avis.texte: I love using this vitamin E mask together with vitamin C drop, both makes my skin tone on my face even and shines throughout the day!

Vitamin E mask has a gel-like texture and contains niacinamide, great for everyone but specially people with oily skin. I have combination skin and use it during the warmer months in the morning along with their vitamin C serum.

I have been using this as a overnight mask. It leaves my skin feeling dewy and hydrated and it is not too heavy. When I wake up my skin feels hydrated and glowy. I have had some breakouts recently and I feel that focusing on hydrating my skin has definitely sped up the healing time and my skin is becoming visibly clearer every time I wake up

I love using this mask at night right before going to bed and after cleaning my skin. I use a small amount of the cream and apply it to my face and tap it into my skin for better absorption. The mask has a beautiful somewhat thicker pudding-like texture, but it absorbs fast into my skin without leaving a sticky feeling. This mask is wonderful for my combination to dry skin. I wake up with silky soft, smooth and hydrated skin that is looking

Excellent composition. The texture of the mask resembles milk jelly or white pudding. The smell of the mask is absolutely not pronounced, not cloying and unobtrusive. The mask is very economical, you need a very small amount to cover the entire face with it. It spreads easily over the skin, absorbs quickly, but still leaves a slight stickiness on the skin, which disappears after 15 minutes. I use it as a leave-in night mask, so there is not much discomfort to use. I really like the action of the mask, in the morning the skin is nourished, fresh and radiant!

I love this versatile product, its gentle yet effective. I can say it's a great moisturizer/mask for my mature combo skin because my skin feels hydrated, plumper and refreshed especially when I wake up the next morning, it gives me a healthy and glowing skin. I definitely recommend this to all skin types especially for mature and dull skin.
Perfect for those people who have hyperpigmentation and dry skin! Love to use this with the vitamin C drop from by wishtrend and the vitamin juice drop from klairs as well.

I love this moisturizer/mask. It is very hydrating and does not break out my skin or cause any irritation. I love it's jelly like texture which is very unique. I use this as a night mask and I wake up with the perfect glow and plumped skin.

avis.titre: wake up with such soft skin afterwards
avis.texte: I use this at night as a moisturizer and it does feel a little sticky but once your skin absorbs it well/ it sets already, the stickyness goes away. I keep it on the entire night and I wake up with such soft skin afterwards!

avis.titre: enhances the effects of Vitamin C
avis.texte: This product can be used as either a sleeping mask or a moisturizer. It has a pudding like consistency which then melts into a cream once smoothed onto the skin. I like to use this mask alongside my Vitamin C products, as it enhances the effects of Vitamin C products and is formulated with Niacinamide which gives various skin-improving effects.

Another Klairs fave! I always use this in the morning to boost the effect of my antioxidants and this complements the different products I try. I like the jelly pudding texture of this and this gives me a good glow even if I'm oily.

avis.titre: my skin just feels and looks wonderful
avis.texte: been using this for years. at night, I apply it last on my face and my skin just feels and looks wonderful in the morning. I know I'm hooked for life with this mask. I've recommended it to my friends and they loved it as well.

I can see serious difference in my skin. I absolutely adore this mask so much. I use this mask after I use my morning toner followed by Klairs vitamin C serum. Plus this mask also contains niacinamide perfect for my acne scars.
Use this as a night mask and you will wake up with the perfect glow and plumped skin!

NO BULL, but this is one of my FAVORITE moisturizers in the market. It makes my skin plump and hydrated especially during the cold season. The creamy, pudding-like texture melts and absorbs easily on my skin without that sticky feeling. Others claim that it helps with fine lines, but I haven't seen that yet in my two weeks of use. With continued use, I believe this moisturizer can help lessen my fine lines too. I use this twice a day as the last step on my skincare routine before putting my sunblock in the morning and 2nd to the last step during my nighttime skincare routine. I love the brightly citrusy scent that is not too overpowering. And the best part of using this moisturizer/mask is IT BRIGHTENS my skin!!!!??

The texture is thick and after applying left my skin feeling sticky. So, I am using this mask only as a sleeping mask and I love the results in the morning. My skin feels well hydrated, smooth, plumped and soft.

It's not the best for dry/very dry skin, doesn't moisturize enough, and it's sticky (clings to dry patches rather than moisturize). It has a very strong fragrance of lemon grass (No one has brought it up!) However the jelly consistency is fun to breakdown. If you have dry skin, you'd need to reapply after 20 minutes, it is a gel consistency so I'm sure everyone who has oily/normal skin would enjoy this.

This works well with vitamin C serum to enhance the brightening effects of Vitamin C. It has a jelly-like texture that melts right away once it's rubbed on your hands and into your face. Since A-mazing bakuchiol cream by bywishtrend is a new product, I heard that the new product goes well with this vitamin e mask for brightening effects and lessening the appearance of acne scars. I use the Vitamin E mask as the last step in my routine if I don't need to apply my moisturizer. For those that are new here, use E6E292C2 to get a discount on your first order

Love the texture, thick, clumpy gel and melts into skin. Subtle scent, lightweight and super gentle. Skin is soft, smooth and supple after application. I only tried this as a sleeping mask and it's actually pretty good!
Love this! I use it for the last step of my night routine. It feel light and hydrating. I am exciting to see the results and will keep using it!
it saves my time with less skincare routine steps. Brighten skin tones and locks moisture for my dehydrated skin until morning without leaving dry. Perfect!!!

I often use the product as an overnight mask as the last step of my night skincare routine. I prefer to add a thick layer or layer it twice as I have dry skin and I need extra moisture. The product comes with a little cute spatula which is great for product distribution. It has kind of gel cream with fun bouncy pudding texture. It provides a cooling feeling when I apply on my face. I do feel a bit sticky at first as it does not absorb right away. This cream is indeed beneficial as the next morning my skin is not greasy but fresh, shiny and hydrated. It makes a noticeable difference on my acne scars after one week of continuous using as well.

I often use the product as an overnight mask as the last step of my night skincare routine. I prefer to add a thick layer or layer it twice as I have dry skin and I need extra moisture. The product comes with a little cute spatula which is great for product distribution. It has kind of gel cream with fun bouncy pudding texture. It provides a cooling feeling when I apply on my face. I do feel a bit sticky at first as it does not absorb right away. This cream is indeed beneficial as the next morning my skin is not greasy but fresh, shiny and hydrated. It makes a noticeable difference on my acne scars after one week of continuous using as well.

avis.titre: HAVEN'T FINISHED THE CONTAINER, YET I ALREADY SEEN SO MUCH R
avis.texte: It's perfect and it is an absolute combo, goes well with Freshly Juiced Vitamin Drop! It contains 2% Niacinamide so it also helps in fading dark spots. It has a pudding-like texture which I'm surprised at first, I thought something was wrong about the texture. But anyway, it is very lightweight and sinks into the skin quickly giving an instant glow. If you're looking to brighten and hydrate your skin then you should get this.

It's perfect and it is an absolute combo, goes well with Freshly Juiced Vitamin Drop! It contains 2% Niacinamide so it also helps in fading dark spots. It has a pudding-like texture which I'm surprised at first, I thought something was wrong about the texture. But anyway, it is very lightweight and sinks into the skin quickly giving an instant glow. If you're looking to brighten and hydrate your skin then you should get this.

This mask which also can be used as a moisturizer is Fortified with antioxidant Vitamin E, the E Mask brightens, improves wrinkles and prevents other signs of aging. The pudding-like texture is in memory foam consistency to reveal brighter, firmer and more hydrated skin, It has a thick jelly-like consistency. I used it with the freshly juiced vitamin drops. In terms of brightness it did help with it whilst also having hydrating effects. This product does contain essential oils which might not be suitable for sensitive skin. I prefer using this at night with the vitamin drops

I really loved this product but it really wasn't enough to help hydrate my skin. I really liked that it help improve my skin elasticity tho. And I definitely saw the brightening effects it had on my skin. Overall it was great just wasn't enough hydration and that's why I would recommend mixing it with the Klairs Rich Moist soothing cream if you want that extra hydration while still getting that glass skin effect.

avis.titre: I will be buying this until the end of time
avis.texte: Title pretty much says it all. I've been using this mask at night for about 6 months now and I love it, my skin has never felt/looked/been this good and so I will be buying and using this vitamin e mask until the end of time.

avis.titre: one of my favourite masks of the year
avis.texte: First of all, I have dry sensitive skin that is exposed to cold winter weather and is on retinoids - so it is dry!!! I enjoy this mask because it is great as either a moisturizer or a mask, layers well and absorbs quickly and easily. Niacinamide is a great addition and calms redness from irritation, dryness or inflammation very well. vitamin E provides good moisture base and is thought to have wound healing properties, so together its a nice combo. What I also value is that this is a LARGE tube - instead of typical 40 or 50 ml you get double the size at 90ml, IE it lasts forever and is great value especially for winter skin care.

After finishing the first bottle a year ago, I decided to repurchase a second to help the cold and dry winter months in Buffalo, NY! I am so glad I did - my skin is supple and glowing the next morning. This is a great addition to my tret nights as well :)

I keep all my products in a mini fridge, applying this and all my Klairs product cold is pure luxuriousness! I have rosacea and I've tried so many products and Rx Medications…. This has helped my skin feel normal and reduce the redness and burning on my face.

Packaging is very nice. With its holographic theme, you'll know that this mask works wonders! It has a pudding like texture that has a gel-type consistency that smells like the unscented toner of Klairs. Somewhat medicinal but very mild. It can be used as a sleeping mask or daily moisturizer but I prefer as the former as it takes time for the skin to absorb it. I love how it gives my skin good effects like it became firmer & hydrated as ever. I think it's another holy grail product for me! Hoping that I'll still love this product during humid days.
Very nice and make your skin glowing! Unexpectedly this cream is mild and won't harm your skin
This moisturizer has a thick jelly consistency that melts upon contact. It leaves my skin feeling hydrated and dewy. Too much can cause skin to feel sticky so you don't need a lot
I love using this right after I use nairs on my lip and chin! It soothes and comforts my face. It also takes the redness away when applied right after! Great product! I recommend highly!

avis.titre: A must to have with any Vitamin C
avis.texte: This mask is unlike any texture I've ever used, it's almost like a thick jelly that once massaged into the skin sinks in like a beautiful gel moisturizer . This moisturizer is a dream for sensitive skin as it contains antioxidants (brightening), Centella Asiatica (soothing), and Niacinamide which can also brighten and support the skin barrier. Personally for me I loved this mask as a morning gel moisturizer, I found it to be light weight, offers oil control and leaves my pores looking blurred and my skin dewy

I use Megan Moon's (youtuber) package (green tea powder wash, rice toner, vitamin c drops and vitamin e mask) and I've gotten many compliments on how my skin glows. Have gotten for my mom and daughter, even my husband asked about it. Highly recommend.

I was kinda hesitant at first with the jelly and pudding-like texture of this sleeping mask but I was surprised that upon application, the mask somehow dissoved and was fully absorbed by the skin. It didn't leave a tacky or weird feeling despite its consistency. I am amazed how my skin was hydratedbovernight. Aside from the moisturization it provides, it helps brighten my skin because of its niacinamide content. I wake up with plum and glowing everyday because of this mask.

I've use a lot of products from expensive to drug store - and this is the best for my dry sensitive skin. There is no irritation and it's very soothing. Makes my skin feel amazing in the morning. Love it - and have repurchased this item over and over again. Gives great soft texture finish with a glow especially when combined with the serum. It's a leave in mask/ cream (jello texture), best part is you don't waste products like other mask which we throw out after one use

This is one of my favorite products! it will keep your face hydrated all night and it doesn't leave a sticky or weird feeling on the face. I live a moisturizer that also aids in improving skin not just hydrating it and that's what this does. 10/10 would recommend to anyone.

This stuff is so great! It had my face very dewy. I was literally glowing! If you're consistent you can stop using it for a while and still look so great! Even tho this is a sleep mask, I would put a small amount on during my morning routine. I stopped using it for like 3 months (I ran out) and definitely saw a difference. Buying another one right now! Absolutely love love love this!

I have used this cream for more than 2 years. The texture is like a mousse. I have a sensitive skin. I like to use it in the night routine along with the Klairs Vitamin C serum. It leaves the skin moisturised and plump in the morning even after washing the face. I have used in the morning as well before sunscreen, it is light on the skin and doesnot leave the skin oily. It works really well when used as a part of the 6-7 step routine. I have repurchased it multiple times and I would definitely recommend it.
I've been using this for about a month and it really does pair nicely with the vitamin c drops from klairs. My skin has been super smooth and glowy.

This has worked wonders for my skin. In combination with vitamin c serum, it has really helped brighten hyperpigmentation and sun spots. I also recover much faster from the stubborn dark spots that pimples leave behind. A little bit goes a long way - I literally scoop half a dime's worth of product and when I warm it up between my fingers it just somehow dissolves into the perfect amount for my entire face. It is sticky and can make your face greasy, therefore I only use this at nighttime. But this thing really comes through for me when it comes to brightening, and I can't see my skincare routine being without it.

I got this as a deluxe sample which prompted me to buy the full size. I use nightly before my moisturizer. It is like jelly but once it touches your skin it melts and feels weightless. I've seen a difference in my complexion for sure.

The texture of this product is more like a jelly custard and a little goes a long way! I use this product daily on fresh, clean skin. I've noticed my skin looks healthier and very refreshed. My skin seems to have an added elasticity to it now and has a natural glow. Great price and worth the amount.

This has essential oils which is risky to those who have sensitive skin but luckily for me even though I have a sensitive skin, thisbproduct works just fine. I recommend this to my nurse friends who are working on a graveyard shift because this has so many antioxidants and this product really hydrates and moisturizes the skin. This has a pudding like texture and it has centella asiatica, niacinamide, adenosine and vitamin e to brighten the skin, soothe the skin and nourish the skin. I apply this at night as the last step of my routune and when i wake up my skin is very moisturized and calm. I notice that my skins texture brightens up too.
I've never used a mask that was as soothing as this one. I use this mask a couple of times a week and it provides additional nourishment my dry skin always needs.

There are so many skincare products out there so, when I try one out to decide if I want to add it to my regimine, I ask "Does it work?" and "What makes it different from all the other similar products?". Firstly, Klairs doesn't produce bad products. Their toner has been a part of my life for many years. I haven't tried the Freshly Juiced Vit E Mask long enough to know if it brightens but it does an excellent job of moisturizing my skin. What makes it different is: the amazing texture!!! It is bouncy and semi-solid in the jar. It becomes a liquid when warmed in the hands. I LOVE the texture and have never seen anything like it. Also, it is dual purpose. A small amount is great as a daily moisturizer. Heavier application at bedtime is a wonderful moisturizing mask. I'm addicted to using it as a bedtime mask. My skin is so soft, pliable and moisturized plus it stays that way all day. This is definitely a permanent part of my bedtime routine.

avis.titre: Surprised with how amazing this mask is!!!
avis.texte: I NEED to start with the texture of this mask. We all know how gorgeous new skin care products look… the first time we open that jar and the surface of the product is perfectly smooth, untouched, and beautiful. Well, this mask makes me feel like I'm opening a new product every day! With a jelly-like pudding consistency, it settles into the container in such a way that the surface looks completely smooth and brand new again the next day! I absolutely love it 😍 This overnight mask lived up to its promise to boost radiance and glow!!! After a few nights of using it as my sleeping mask, my skin felt rejuvenated! My skin looked brighter and healthier the more I used it! I am soooooo happy with the results! This mask will definitely be a staple in my skin care routine!

I use this as the final step to my nighttime routine. First the klairs toner, vitamin c serum and then this vitamin e mask. It is the perfect finish and leaves my skin feeling supple and moisturized. A little goes a long way and I like the jelly like texture of it.

I use this vitamin E mask several times a week and sometimes in the mornings if my skin needs a little boost. I simply love the consistency and the way it feels when I apply it. I can feel it absorbing into my skin and I have seen a change in my skin too! This is one product I am so glad a tried and I will keep using from now on. A little really does go a long way with this product so the value is also terrific!

This is my favourite sleeping mask. I use it 3 or 4 times a week. It really helps with my blemishes and dark spots. The niacinamide amount is not too low or too high, just perfect for my skin. I'm in love with the texture .
This sleeping mask is literally the best one I've ever used! Highly recommend!
I love this mask very much. I use it in the evening and from time to time with z Vitamin C serum. This combo makes my skin look so nice, and after some time my scars are beginning to fade.
I don't know how this works so amazing with my skin but it does. Mostly because my skin is so sensitive to everything. It's so smooth and creamy too.

I use Klairs Freshly Juiced Vitamin E Mask after Wishtrends Green Tea Enzyme Powder Wash, Klairs Supple Preparation Unscented Toner and Klairs Freshly Juiced Vitamin Drop (Vitamin C Serum). I also sometimes use Klairs Rich Moist Soothing Cream when I want a little more moisture. I live in coastal Florida where there is a lot of exposure to the sun's UV rays which wreak havoc on skin. I have age spots and freckle sun spots from over exposure. I started using this regimen about 6 months ago after receiving the set as a gift from my sister. She heard about the set by Youtuber Megan Moon. Via a link on her YouTube page, she purchased a set and after a few months of use my sister's adult acne was completely gone. Her rosacea was totally gone. I saw her at Christmas and she gifted me a set. I have been using it (not every day) for 6 months and even with my neglect, the skin spots have lightened significantly, wrinkles appear less defined and my overall facial skin looks healthy and youthful for my age. People often tell me I look 10-15 years younger than I am. I'm very happy with this product and the whole set. I love the way my skin feels. I purchased 3 more sets, another for myself and 1 for each of my daughters. I plan to keep using and explore other products.
